# Seed-library prompt history

The final accepted image was made by editing a prior self-generated image. No external reference image was supplied. Two transparent attempts did not meet the output standard and are not counted as successful cases or published as image assets. The final output is opaque, on a light-gray background. Image generation is stochastic, so these prompts do not guarantee identical pixels.

## Initial transparent attempt

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: an original reusable 3D-style game or interface illustration, isolated with genuine alpha transparency.
Primary request: a miniature seed-library greenhouse on a compact floating chunk of earth, rendered as a polished tactile diorama asset.
Subject: one small six-sided greenhouse with cream painted metal framing and clear lightly frosted glass panels, one closed door, two shelves holding simple terracotta pots and young green seedlings. The greenhouse sits on one irregular ochre soil island with three visible stratified layers, a patch of moss, a short curved stepping-stone path, and one small unlettered wooden notice board. Two thin roots hang naturally from the underside.
Style/medium: high-quality stylized 3D product render, physically plausible rounded geometry, miniature architectural model, clay-like earth and matte ceramics contrasted with subtle translucent glass. Original visual design, not a known game asset.
Composition/framing: square image, three-quarter isometric view from above, whole object centered with generous transparent padding on all sides; show roof, front door and one side; clean separated silhouette and crisp fine edges.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral studio illumination from upper left, delicate self-shadowing on the object only.
Color palette: warm ivory, terracotta, moss green, ochre soil and restrained teal window reflections.
Text: none.
Constraints: actual transparent background, not a checkerboard pattern, no backdrop or floor plane, no cast shadow beyond the object, no people, faces, animals, logos, watermark, lettering, extra islands, levitating fragments, glowing effects or clutter. Keep the diorama readable at thumbnail scale.


## Second transparent attempt

Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the supplied original transparent miniature seed-library greenhouse diorama.
Make one correction: give this whole existing object more clean transparent breathing room. Scale the entire unchanged diorama down uniformly so its visible opaque silhouette fits comfortably within the central 76 percent of a square canvas, leaving at least 12 percent transparent padding above, below, left and right, including roof finial and both hanging roots. Keep every part of the original greenhouse, shelves, pots, soil, path and colors in the same relative position, shape and style.
Preserve the original three-quarter camera angle, lighting, material textures and genuine alpha transparency. Clean stray colored pixels and bright green or yellow halos just outside the silhouette. Keep the object itself solid and crisp except for naturally translucent glass and anti-aliased edge pixels. No new content, no background, no floor, no cast shadow outside the object, no text, no checkerboard, no cropping.


## Accepted opaque-background edit

Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the supplied miniature seed-library greenhouse diorama.
Create a polished final opaque-background presentation of this original object. Keep the greenhouse design, six-sided roof, door, visible pot shelves, terracotta pots, seedlings, little wooden noticeboard, stepping stones, soil island, moss, dangling roots, camera angle and material style recognizable.
Replace all transparency with a completely opaque pale warm-grey studio background. Render the whole greenhouse and soil island cleanly into this studio, removing every bright yellow, green or red edge halo and every stray pixel. The background is smooth and plain. Add only a subtle soft oval shadow below the floating island so it feels like a crafted 3D object in a studio.
Square composition with all of the complete object within the central 74 percent of the image and comfortable blank margins on every side, especially above the roof finial and below both roots. No clipping. Clean crisp silhouette; believable smooth antialiasing.
Soft upper-left studio lighting, gentle warm ivory metal, terracotta pots, rich natural moss, tactile clay soil strata. Do not add any text, brands, watermark, new props or extra objects. Final image is opaque, not a transparent cutout.
